notes: Source read in full: bill-text/119-HR-8205.txt (Engrossed-in-House, 119 lines / 4,820 chars) + referenced PL 117-79 / HR 3537 (ref-text/bill-117-hr-3537.txt, the 2021 Act this bill amends). This is a clean 4-section reauthorization: Sec 2 extends the $100M/year Sec 7 authorization and the Sec 2(f) grants sunset from 2026 to 2031 (strike '2026'/insert '2031'); Sec 3 adds renewal safety/efficacy review (Sec 2(b)(4)), prompt adverse-event reporting to the grant-making institution (Sec 2(c)(4)), and a phase 2/3 combined-trial expansion of the 'phase 3' definition (Sec 2(e)(4)); Sec 4 renames the heading and adds an 18-month FDA action plan + 5-year report. Every figure ($100M, FY2022-2026, FY2031, Sept 30 2026/2031, 18 months, 5 years, 6 months prior, Dec 2021, section 312.32), direction (extend/expand/rename/add), entity (HHS/Secretary, FDA/Commissioner, NIH, small-business sponsor, 21 USC 360ee note / 360aa note / 360ee-1), and attribution (which paragraph is added to which section) resolves to the bill source or the registered referenced source. Minor items: Sec 3 detail omits the 351(a) PHS Act pathway from the prior 'participating clinical trial' definition and glosses 505(i) as 'investigational new drug exemption' (accurate); likelihoodReason carries the usual structural-metadata (Quigley sponsor, 103 cosponsors, Calendar No. 466) and predictive/breadth-of-support framing lines (bipartisan, friction points, triple-digit-cosponsor defeat) — recorded not-in-source, non-material. featured_quotes[] (Quigley, Calvert) are Congressional Record floor quotes with no CR source file registered, so out of audit scope (bill-text-only). criticisms[] empty. Stage/vote consistent: stage 'house'/'Passed House' matches votes[] (House On Passage, 2026-07-22, Passed, Voice Vote) and the bill's 'Passed the House of Representatives July 22, 2026.' attestation. No material fidelity errors.
